title: Czech building-materials distributor Pro-Doma reportedly hit by cyberattack, back to paper
date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November 2026); no earlier date for the attack is stated.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source (Czech outlet); no city given
summary: Hospodářské noviny reports that Pro-Doma, a Czech distributor of building materials, was hit by a large cyberattack on its internal company systems. According to the article, staff now write documents by hand, customers can pay only in cash, and the company cannot deliver goods already ordered. The cause, attacker and duration are not given in the visible part of the article.
plain: Hospodářské noviny reports that a large cyberattack on Pro-Doma's internal systems forced the Czech building-materials distributor back to handwritten documents and cash-only payments.
exec: Per Hospodářské noviny, a cyberattack left Pro-Doma on paper, cash-only payments, and unable to deliver goods already ordered.
impact: Handwritten documents, cash-only payments and undelivered orders, per Hospodářské noviny.

validation.note: Only Hospodářské noviny (byznys.hn.cz) read; part of the article is paywalled. Pro-Doma's own statement was not read.
